outlineSystemLanguage: Original tested Chinese system reused verbatim; purposes may be English or Chinese
semanticSystemLanguage: Original tested short English system reused verbatim
geometrySystem: Original ScenePrompt.system plus already-declared anchor spatial protocol
api: Outline/geometry formal generateJSON Direct wrapper; semantic structured generateJSONDirect plus strict contract/ID/face/order validation
phaseFailure: Preserve evidence, stop remaining phases of that case, then continue next fixed case. Never substitute an old asset.
rendering: Real native meshes->GLB/USDZ->exact USDZ Apple import->front/three-quarter PNG only where valid
cpuDeadlineBoundary: One deadline covers NN calls and is checked between native CPU/renderer steps; synchronous native operations are not forcibly interrupted mid-call and actual overrun/cleanup is reported.
visualAcceptance: Independent per-image review after execution, never inferred from JSON/format counters
